items.title: 8.5.2 Why is Intellectual Property Important? (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of printed 8.4.2 Why is Intellectual Property Important? (PDF 203).

blocks.text: Intellectual property is liye aham hai ke yeh logon ko apne khayalat aur creations (banayi hui cheezein) mehfooz rakhne mein madad deti hai. Jab koi nayi cheez ijad karta hai ya koi art ka kaam banata hai, to intellectual property ke laws pakka karte hain ke us ka munafa sirf usi ko mile. Yeh hifazat logon ko naye khayalat aur innovations (naye tareeqe aur cheezein) laate rehne ka hosla deti hai, kyunke unhein maloom hota hai ke mehnat ka reward (inaam) milega. Mukhtasar yeh ke intellectual property creativity ko sahara deti hai aur tarraqi ko aage barhati hai, kyunke banane walon ko apni mehnat ka faida milta hai. (Kitab ne yahan bhi 8.5 ke neeche number 8.4.2 chhapa hai.)
Maqsad: students rozmarra zindagi mein intellectual property ki alag alag qismein pehchanein.

items: Students class mein koi aisi cheez layein jo woh roz istemal karte hain, jaise mobile phone, kitab ya kapra.
Har student apni cheez se judi kam az kam ek qisam ki intellectual property pehchane (maslan brand ka naam, design ya content).
Baat karein ke intellectual property rights in cheezon ki hifazat kaise karte hain aur yeh banane walon ya companies ke liye kyun aham hai.

blocks.prompt: Class Activity: mobile phone mein intellectual property ki kaunsi qismein ho sakti hain?
blocks.explanation: Phone ki nayi technology par patents; brand ka naam aur logo trademark; phone ki khaas shakal industrial design; aur us ka software copyright se mehfooz. (Misal hamari taraf se samjhane ke liye.)

blocks.title: Did You Know?
blocks.text: Kya aap jante hain ke Pakistan ka apna Intellectual Property Organization (IPO) hai? Yeh idara mulk mein intellectual property rights register (darj) karne aur un ki hifazat ka zimmedar hai, ta ke creators aur businesses ko un ki innovation ka inaam mile.

blocks.prompt: Agar har invention ko koi bhi azaadi se copy kar sake to innovation par kya asar hoga?
blocks.explanation: Kitab ke mutabiq IP ki hifazat logon ko naye khayalat laane ka hosla deti hai kyunke unhein inaam milta hai. Agar copy karna azaad ho to inventor (ijad karne wala) apni mehnat aur kharch ka inaam nahi le payenge, is liye kam log naye khayalat par waqt aur paisa lagayenge aur innovation kam ho jayegi.

items: IP khayalat aur creations bachati hai; munafa banane wale ko milta hai.
Is se innovation aur tarraqi barhti hai; Pakistan mein IPO IP rights register karta hai.
